entities.summary: Ata Bey al-Ayyubi was an Ottoman civil servant who served as president and prime minister of Syria. Born to a prominent political family of Al-Ayoubi in Damascus, Syria, he studied public administration in Istanbul, and began his professional career in the Ottoman civil service.
